revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a paved campus walkway beside a building. Scene includes benches, planted edges, painted loading-bay concrete, and partial shadow from a nearby structure, with clear subject detail. Front-oblique view, slightly distant framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, and enough surrounding context to judge body support. Main subject is an older adult man with a stocky build wearing a charcoal cardigan and practical shoes in subdued gray and olive clothing, already fully prone on the ground with no active limb support lifting the torso. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, a cart near one edge, ample negative space around the subject. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
